about: Public library pages for California (owner decision, 23 November 2026), built by tools/seo/build-pages.mjs with tools/seo/check-pages.mjs. Every California public library system in server/data/libraries.json has a page at /libraries/<slug>, with the directory's facts and the first ten books of shared/us-book-pool.json to check live, on a reader's tap. Nothing is checked in advance: BiblioCommons' terms forbid automated collection, and its availability is never stored (server/data/catalog-policies.json). A slug, once given, is kept: it is the library's /select/ link name (the four reviewed guides keep their guide slug; a /select/ link name with a hash suffix drops the suffix). leftOut lists the California entries that are not public library systems, with the reason; a new California entry must be added to one of the two lists (tools/seo/build-pages.test.mjs).

leftOut.reason: MARINet is the shared catalog of the Marin County library consortium, with college and university libraries among its members; Marin County Free Library has its own entry with the same 23 locations.
